the LQG-LTR controller is better for the Umbria earthquake and the MPC controller is better for Mammoth Lakes and Mexico earthquakes, and that a “black box model” obtained by CLOE is a good tool to implement the control strategies.
the proposed control system is capable of reducing the maximum displacement of the table and the maximum acceleration of the soil model in the three earthquake scenarios.

(1) The LQG-LTR controller is not able to control the shaking table when the gravity number is 3.0 and the earthquake is the Umbria Italy in April 29, 1984; and (2) The MPC controller is able to control the table for the same conditions, but the controller has a very large bandwidth and it is difficult to implement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a control system for an electro-hydraulic one degree of freedom shaking table for simulations in a centrifuge.
the design of control system for a one-freedy degree electro-hydraulics shaking table for simulates earthquake on scale soil models that are influenced in a centrifugal force.
the design of control techniques that can be used to control a one-freedy degree electro-hydraulical shaking table that is exposed to a centrifugal force to obtain a soil scale model N times bigger.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LQG-LTR control strategy is the best one for this application.
the Model Predictive Control is a better option than the LQG-LTR control technique.
both control strategies are effective and the model predictive control has a better response than LQG-LTR control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Model Predictive Controller is better than the Linear Quadratic Gaussian controller, but both are better than the open loop control.
it is possible to control the shaking table with the mentioned control techniques.

the control system presented in this article can be used to control any shaking table that is used to simulate earthquakes in soil scale model, and that is exposed to a centrifugal force, with the purpose of simulating gravity force on it.

the LQG-LTR controller is more effective than the MPC controller.
the LQG-LTR control technique can be applied to control this kind of shaking table.
